subject: C41
required_fixes: R1 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/response-pane.tsx:85-92,112-140 and request-editor.tsx:277-281: a historical response takes precedence over the running transfer and hides its Cancel request control. Independently reproduced with the real RequestEditor in jsdom: open a request without sending, choose an old run from History, then Send with its result held pending and a RunningView for the new transfer. The status says Sending and Send is disabled, but the pane still shows the old 200 OK and offers no Cancel request. The identical running state without a history selection shows Cancel. setRun(null) does not change runId when it was already null, so fromHistory survives; the record-first header then suppresses progress and cancellation. Selecting history during a transfer has the same precedence problem. This regresses C15/T14 cancellation. Acceptance: keep current transfer progress and cancellation reachable regardless of the response being inspected; add a component regression holding Send pending after showing history, asserting that Cancel dispatches the active run ID exactly once, history remains immutable, and no request is resent.
